:::{#def-minimum}
#### Minimum

Let $A \subseteq \reals$.
A number $m$ is the **minimum** of $A$,
written $\min A$,
if $m \in A$ and $m \le a$ for all $a \in A$.

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#rem-minimum-may-not-exist}
#### Not every set has a minimum

The set $\cb{3, 1, 4}$ has minimum $1$,
and the [interval](sets-functions.qmd#def-interval) $[0, 1]$ has minimum $0$.
The interval $(0, 1]$ has no minimum:
every element $a$ of it has a smaller element, $a/2$, also in it.

:::
